4.title: I love being a girl
4.body:
Last night i attended @epiphanyproductionspresents (on insta) drag show. it was underscores themed, specifically the wallsocket album. i vividly remember walking down morse street in rogers park west almost to clark, hearing horror movie soundtrack play in my earbuds in the summer of 2023. i did not understand this album when i first heard it. its all so laughably predictable, but now hearing it recontextualized after socially transitioning was a moving experience. there were many moments when i cried. the performance was amazing and im very thankful to have been invited

i met Lady Piphany when i received a DM from her saying that she found my Snel destiny swap card. i specifically remember having a difficult time letting go of that card, because i was so happy with how it turned out, and how it felt. i left it in a library, shortly after found by lady piphany.

She was kind enough to show my music video for Kinda Heavy Ivory Version as an opening to the show, and it was a very surreal experience to hear the words that were once coming to me while slowly meditatively walking across the beach now resonating in a dark room with stage lights and a room full of wallsocket fans. i am deeply thankful to feel in some way that i am contributing to a very important conversation. i hope i can continue to trust my voice and make things im scared of. i was thinking of underscores when making the music video, and it is like sweet honey that this has come from it. so so thankful.

i continue to be a little overwhelmed with how much stuff im making and trying to keep up with putting it all out there. ive been writing a TON recently, and a lot is coming together. all in time

all that said. Lady Piphany said a lot of very nice words at the opening of the show, but what stands out in my mind is that the most meaningful thing for me was being called "she" very loudly in front of everyone. it made me so happy. i was(am) a girl. its so stupid. its so small. so simple. but the simple small things are what demonstrate we understand. sometimes a slight shift of weight, can mean more than 100 words.

i think the common misunderstanding of becoming "triggered" when being misgendered grossly misrepresents how subtle the despair of dysphoria is. i dont feel anything when someone misgenders me other than disappointment, and discouragement. a confirmation that the world i fear does not accept me indeed does not accept me. its boring. its sad. its nothing. it shows that people have the capacity to walk this life as robots, empty, and non feeling. the evidence of this capacity makes it difficult to believe the version of the world where i belong is the real one. and the most painful part of this experience for me, is i just forget. i get into this ruts where i literally forget what the euphoria feels like and i get stuck in a hole of being depressed and not knowing why. the notable experience is the euphoria, not the dysphoria. the dysphoria is the first "normal" i ever understood. the euphoria, even though it is heaven, it is strange and scary and unfamiliar compared to the ocean of empty dull grey unsettling unbearable dissonance in the back of my ribs. this feeling in the back of my ribs tells me something that is easy to believe: "i am invisible". 

euphoria, when it shines its scalding light, screams "you never had to believe that". it is always very painful for me in a way to experience the best thing ive felt yet. im always horryfied that it will not stay around. the ocean of dispair finds me, and the only land i have is the islands of small moments where i feel alive. i have felt alive this week. i am a girl :3 

wallsocket puts so many feelings that are impossible to say into sound. it reminded me that other people are feeling what i feel.

dunno if this is tmi, tbqh idc.

6.title: it is a full moon, and there was an eclipse last night :)
6.body:
hi! 

today i have uploaded a video that is an artsy music lyric video of a couple experimental emotional dance tracks. it literally came out on the eclipse. i didnt even notice until yesterday.  :) 

Ratdoodle - “EVERYTHING, JUST TO REMEMBER” EP 

now available everywhere!


im turning 29 in a few days. 

28 felt like the first year i was alive. i am going to miss this year dearly, it was more painful than anything ive experienced, i felt more alive and real than i ever had before. my life becomes more colorful and real everyday as i let go of what i thought i knew about who i am, and what it means to be happy. life is enough. you are enough. it all can be enough. even if thats pain. even if the only thing it is, is pain. we will always have the trees and dirt to hear us. we will always have gravity, and the sound of nothing, and annoying people. 

nothing will ever be enough until it all is. 

nothing is, until it all is

it cannot be if it is not being. it must be, to be, how it is. it is. 

it is. 

it is. 


i feel so happy, so full, i feel like im frantically trying to grasp at all of the things im experiencing as my eyes are being opened to what the joys of existence can mean. im scared the understanding will disappear, because i know it will. but when it does, i know it will come back. and i am here again. 

in the palm of my hand. 

i must let go as time passes. time, my mortal enemy, u create me, and withhold me from connection to everything. distance of time is more painful than a distance of miles. time does not heal. time can make a wound fester. the longer someone is gone, the more i forget. who i was when i was with them. the more time passes, the more the scrape shapeshifts into a funeral where they are burying an old picture of me, and i did not ask for this. 

i still wish i was 5’1” and a girl

today has been okay

i love drawing comics of the fam so much. theyre becoming alive. and they will keep becoming alive. i miss them everyday less and less. 

maybe ideas not fully created yet are like spirits were not friends with yet, because time is catching up to the relationship. 

so many ways to create life. 

my album DEVIL HORNED CAROLINA LOVER GIRL 
is coming out on my birthday, sep 1. i will be 29. 

i hope u have a good day and are kind to yourself. you deserve to feel good and be happy.

7.title: i have been ill, but today i see the light of day once more
7.body:
just like that beaver that says something about winter every 6 months or whatever

i have been mostly sweating under a blanket the past few days

i am 29!! :))

my album DEViL HORNED CAROLiNA LOVER GiRL came out on my birthday and i wont lie ive been listening to it quite a bit. its always nice to have the music ive been listening to finally be on the platform i actually use to listen to music with. i hope everyone likes my music! :3

ive been learning a lot of little random things recently, like how to make yarn and lots of things about bugs, and im a big fan of that. i love random little knowledge moments. art is really about your perspective. the more you look, the more you see. the more you see, the more youre capable of imagining. a leaf is not simply the shape of a leaf, but all its tiny veins within the quiet green fabric singing together to create a melody. a sound, a vibration, that creates light, and this light our brain recognizes as a leaf. do not draw what your brain recognizes. draw what your soul hears when you listen. you can forget how to draw a shape, you can never forget how to draw 'yourself'. maybe i think every piece an artist makes is inherently a self portrait. how is one to possibly escape ones own perspective enough to conclude a certain shape is definitively, objectively, definable without the fraction of context you needed in order to draw it.

the fraction of context you offer, (your perspective), is your view of reality. this is what every piece you make is. this is what the viewer's soul "hears". whether you drew a chair, a tiger, or a boat, your soul is what lies on the page. grow yourself to maintain the garden of inspiration within you. grow yourself by looking more, but look with your soul. dont look at shapes.

ive been having a lot of fun recording tik toks with the squad, they dont pop out much, theyre usually busy. but its cool to get them in a few. 

gonna post a music video soon for PiNK SKY ! :) as soon as im done with it

more to come! peace! swag out!

8.title: STOP READING THIS AND GO MAKE YOUR WEEBIE :3
8.body:
no really! by visiting " ratdoodle.com/account ", OR by clicking the "Profile" button on the homepage, you can make an account and create your very own Weebie! :) 

Just choose a name, primary color, and secondary color, and youre all set! Check back on your account page to see your pet Weebie anytime!

-- aside from Weebies --

Glitchmaster visited over this past weekend to assist me in showing Ratdoodle Adventure at Chicago Indie Game Showcase (C.I.G.S.) !!

we both had a blast, and it was very exhausting and eye opening to things we can be working on, and direction to go in moving forward! but also it was very fulfilling to simply witness so many people experience our creation. it was hard work putting together the build we brought, but, and i hope everyone who tried the game would agree, i think it was worth it. all around such a beautiful experience and im SO thankful/honored to be able to participate. it felt like most of the time there was someone waiting to try it out, and others watching behind them. it was a good day for us after a very stressful week of putting our nose to the grindstone. it probably did not help that i waited until a week before the event to start work on the demo build. it was an intimidating project. im very proud of what we were able to pull off. grapebird too of course put together great work as always

i hope when anyone sees what i create they feel empowered to create as well. I want everyone to be reminded of their limitless potential when they think of my creations. there is always joy, there is always light, you can always choose, you always have the power to let go and accept peace into your view

im learning how to crochet, i took some really pretty pictures of frogs, im playing guitar a lot on the beach. go outside, and sing to the dirt. the phone doesnt need every part of you. im eating a lot of sandwiches and fruit. been resting the past couple days, reorientating myself a bit to think about next steps. im working on putting a lot together for merch :3 im very excited

—— non weebie info about my life: ——-


today i have made a song with love. its very good. 

its been a really long time since ive made a song with love. ive been struggling with writing recently because its hard for me to embrace love. im excited for u to hear this one. im not sure if ill do a second pass or not. im really resonating with how its sounding. sometimes i think about what an album would sound like if i gave a shit about making it clean. some part of me genuinely think it ruins the magic to even edit anything. the most alive pieces i look back are the moments that feel organic and messy and unique. not moments that feel specifically curated. the curation is profound when its construction is evidence of some thing that could cynically referred to as luck. realistically intuition based on pattern recognition. optimistically the profound nature of moments constructed by “randomness “ are evidence of a “divine consciousness” or animalistic state of unconscious action so aligned that thoughts become again and thought again and action again in a simultaneous tension held like 2 magnets of opposite poles being squished together. curation, and the unknown. creating a pressure, and an overflow of the energetic physics of the situation pushing everything out of you into physical reality. a path created by and from and for your spirit 

what is interesting to me and maybe even a little frustrating is that the best recording will be a “real moment” but then it instantly becomes a fucked up meta game of balancing what being performative means for you personally and becoming aware of when you’re in that state of being, which becomes a moving target over time because when you become comfortable as an artist you become comfortable with an identity, limiting your perspective to your definition of yourself. its so easy to develop a routine of “how” to show up “correctly”. this is an illusion. there is no “way” to show up. you are the definer of you. nothing else. 


all that to say there are frequently songs i hear that just feel so painfully performative to me. but it is a performance. and everyone loves performance. performative things are used to perform because thats what everyone expects and its what works. but its like. it feels so vacant. im not making music to perform at the end of the day. music for me is a portal into myself, music is what oozes out of my breathe when i am looking into the horizon as the sun sets, when i feel good, i sing, when i feel inspired, i play the drums in my mind. i tune in and out of different instruments in my head like im muting and unmuting like in a DAW. once voice at a time because ill be singing it (every producer beatboxes, it a prerequisite) 

ive been very very attracted to rhythm lately. feeling it. breaking it down. putting it into my arms and legs. its very satisfying. ive also been listening to a lot of music that inspires me lately. 

no halo - mykel
touch heaven - jake hogan
pretend friend - sam austins
for once - baileyrp
